\section*{About the reproduced appendices}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{About the reproduced appendices}
Appendices~\ref{app:phase1}--\ref{app:pkgdesign} reproduce the repository's theory
documents at commit \texttt{ec3644f}. They were converted mechanically from
Markdown to \LaTeX\ with pandoc (\path{tools/make_appendices.py}); the text,
proofs, justification tags and correction notes are those of the source. The only
additions are typesetting aids: an anchor at each labelled result (the main
text's ``go to the result'' links land there), a proof index at the head of each
appendix, line breaks in file names, and scaling of a few displays wider than the
page. PHASE1b and PHASE2d are not reproduced (proposals, not reviewed; see
Section~\ref{sec:did}).

\paragraph{Reading the cross-references.} The reproduced documents cite each other
by prefix and keep their own section numbers, so ``\S4'' inside an appendix means
that document's \S4, not this report's Section~4. The prefixes map to appendices
as follows:
\begin{center}\small
\begin{tabular}{@{}lll@{}}
\toprule Prefix in the sources & Document & Appendix \\ \midrule
P1 & \path{PHASE1_foundations.md} & \ref{app:phase1} \\
2a & \path{PHASE2a_rxc.md} & \ref{app:phase2a} \\
2b & \path{PHASE2b_districts.md} & \ref{app:phase2b} \\
2c & \path{PHASE2c_monotone.md} & \ref{app:phase2c} \\
P3 & \path{PHASE3_inference.md} & \ref{app:phase3} \\
5a & \path{PHASE5a_sign_module.md} & \ref{app:phase5a} \\
PD & \path{PACKAGE_DESIGN.md} (\S\S2, 5, 7, 8) & \ref{app:pkgdesign} \\
1b, 2d & \path{PHASE1b_monotone_did.md}, \path{PHASE2d_did.md} & not reproduced \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
A tag such as ``[2a:L1]'' or ``[2c:M3]'' means ``result L1 of 2a'' and so on.

\paragraph{Planning and process material.} PHASE1 is the original planning
document. Its ``(to prove)'' labels mark statements that are proved later, in
Appendices~\ref{app:phase2a} and \ref{app:phase2b} (the status table,
Section~\ref{sec:status}, gives the result that proves each one). First-person text
in it, and elsewhere, addresses the project owner. The correction notes in
parentheses, the verification logs and PHASE5a's internal review log are part of
the audit trail and are reproduced as written.
